cohort_definition.exclusion_reason: not one of the five consecutive sweeps explicitly requested after the report update

method.future_error: phase/gain of measured future R_i divided by training prediction
method.log_harmonic_model: log R = a + j(phi-2*pi*(f-f0)*tau) + sum_k q_k exp(-j*2*pi*k*(f-f0)*delta)
method.model_selection_warning: comparison of model families on the five future sweeps is exploratory; a later untouched cohort is required for confirmatory selection
method.raw_replay_scope: run.json phasors are SHA-256 pinned here; raw-IQ replay is documented in the source campaign reports and is not repeated by this analyzer
